name: Yun Jin
notes: Re-checked against genshin-builds.com (2026-10-30). KQM, Game8 and genshin-builds agree on 4pc Husk of Opulent Dreams first, a DEF% or ER Sands, a DEF% Goblet, a DEF% or CRIT Rate (for Favonius Lance) Circlet and the same weapon pool. Weapons differ in the lead: KQM Footprint of the Rainbow, Game8 Engulfing Lightning, genshin-builds Favonius Lance (also the most used there); Favonius Lance leads here and the others follow, with Kitain Cross Spear added from genshin-builds. Noblesse Oblige, Archaic Petra and Scroll of the Hero of Cinder City are team-specific sets (KQM; Noblesse and Scroll also on genshin-builds). Talent order: KQM is character level, then Burst; genshin-builds is Burst > Skill > Normal Attack; Game8's line was garbled by the draft script (it repeats the Burst and the Skill). The card uses Burst > Skill > Normal Attack. Her Burst (Cliffbreaker's Banner) adds a share of her DEF (32% to 58% at levels 1 and 10) to the team's Normal Attacks, so DEF is the scaling stat. The kit's 'check' line is the Burst's own hit (Skill DMG 244% to 439%, elemental curve, ATK-based), small beside the DEF bonus. ER is KQM's table: without Favonius, 180-225 with other Geo units, 240-270 solo, 160-200 with Xilonen; with Favonius 155-185 with other Geo units; 200 is used for a team with another Geo unit and no Favonius. Neither source gives numeric DEF or CRIT goals. Partners are inferred (Normal Attack carries such as Itto or Gorou, Pyro and Cryo).
